title: Recipe 17 — Observability (six layers, every one of them opt-in)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 17 is six layers, ordered from ‘what is my agent doing right now’ to ‘every event in Datadog with gen_ai semantic conventions.’ The bus has no subscribers until you ask for one.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe and starters are never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the layers only have events to carry once a real turn runs.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the harness the six layers point at

beats.label: Type recipe 01's harness
beats.cue: “Observability is per-deployment, not per-spec — so start from the plainest recipe-01 agent, unchanged. Nothing in these seven lines mentions tracing.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean before we turn a single layer on — so anything that shows up later is the env vars' doing, not the spec's.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “No trace block, no metrics block, no exporter block. Observability is runtime wiring — the IR is exactly what recipe 01 lowers to.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target cli — no observability surface in it

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN with no key. The trace bus is in that bundle with zero subscribers, costing nothing.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “The bus is constructed here and handed to the chat loop. Every layer after this is a subscriber you opt into by env var.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · Layers 1–2 — the JSONL and the live printer

beats.label: Layer 2 — watch the turn unfold
beats.cue: [needs-key] “CREWHAUS_TRACE=pretty and the events stream to stderr, colour-coded, with token deltas collapsed into one rolling line.”
beats.command: CREWHAUS_TRACE=pretty crewhaus run live/crewhaus.yaml --prompt 'In one sentence: what is a trace event bus?'

verify.note: one turn with the pretty printer attached; needs Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Layer 2 — the machine format
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Same events, one JSON object per line on stdout. This is the format meant for your own tooling.”
beats.command: CREWHAUS_TRACE=json crewhaus run live/crewhaus.yaml --prompt 'Name one thing you can do.' > live/trace.jsonl

verify.note: writes the JSON-Lines event stream to live/trace.jsonl; needs Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Layer 1 — the always-on session log
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Nobody opted into this one. Every run writes its own JSONL at mode 0600, and this is what --resume reads back.”

verify.note: the recipe's own line — the session JSONL only exists after a keyed run

beats.label: Prove the three sink forms parse
beats.cue: “stdout, textfile, http — the exact three strings the recipe prints, resolved by the collector out of the bundle we just checked. No key, no network.”
beats.command: bun --cwd live/dist -e 'import { parseEnv } from "@crewhaus/metrics-collector"; for (const v of ["stdout", "textfile:/var/lib/node_exporter/crewhaus.prom", "http:9464"]) console.log("CREWHAUS_METRICS=" + v.padEnd(44), JSON.stringify(parseEnv(v)))'

verify.note: prints {kind:stdout} · {kind:textfile,path} · {kind:http,port:9464} — the sink grammar of Layer 3, resolved from live/dist/node_modules

beats.label: Expose a Prometheus endpoint
beats.cue: [needs-key] “http:9464 and the run serves /metrics for a scrape — turns, tool calls, tokens, errors, and the three histograms including time-to-first-token.”

verify.note: GET http://localhost:9464/metrics while the run is alive; needs Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Ship OTLP spans to a collector
beats.cue: [needs-key] “One endpoint variable and the lifecycle events pair into spans — chat, tool, mcp — with gen_ai.* attributes. Token deltas ride as span events, not sub-spans, because sub-spans-per-token explodes an APM bill.”

verify.note: needs a local OTLP collector on :4318 and Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Turn cost tracking on
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The tracker subscribes to model_response, prices it from the table, and emits cost_accrual in microdollars — integers, so a long-running sum never drifts.”
beats.command: CREWHAUS_COST_TRACKING=1 crewhaus run live/crewhaus.yaml --prompt 'Summarize what you just cost me.'

verify.note: cost_accrual events need a real model_response; needs Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Read the dollar total back
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Broken down by model, input versus output tokens, and total USD. A model id the pricing table has never seen increments a counter instead of throwing — a new release does not crash production.”

verify.note: reads the cost_accrual events the previous beat wrote

groups.title: One more thing · Layer 6 — the vendor exporters, proven end to end

beats.label: Type the recipe's production block
beats.cue: “All six layers at once, as a real deploy would set them: JSON events for the aggregator, metrics for the scrape, OTel to the collector, cost attributed per tenant, Datadog for the operations team.”

beats.label: Open what we just wrote
beats.cue: “Six exports and one boot. Total runtime overhead is low — the bus is in-process and the network sends are batched.”

beats.label: Run the Datadog exporter smoke
beats.cue: “The recipe's own Try-it: spans, metrics and logs through a stub collector, asserted against the gen_ai conventions — and the credential-leak guard proving DD_API_KEY never reaches a log line.”

verify.note: ALL PROBES PASSED — 5 model spans flushed, [REDACTED:DD_API_KEY] present, attach gated on DD_API_KEY / DD_TRACE_ENABLED. Redirected rather than piped so the exit code is the smoke's own

beats.label: Read the probe log
beats.cue: “Probe D is the one to point at: no env var, no exporter. That is what ‘auto-attaching’ actually means.”

beats.label: And the Honeycomb one
beats.cue: “Same pipeline, second vendor, side by side — each consumes the same bus, so spans go to every configured destination.”

verify.note: ALL PROBES PASSED — dataset header + api.eu1 host routing + the same scrubApiKey guard
